notes: Hand written and synthetic, never captured. Room looks as the Aabahran server prints them, built from its own format strings and area files, with the Room.Info, Room.Chars and Room.Items packets where the server sends them, before the text up to d50e4a24 and after the people since. Each line says where it comes from, room says whether it lists an army, a thing or a person, the lines a Room trigger matches, target on a case is what you gave tar and on a line marks the line of that person, and preset names any other color the Room and time colors preset gives it. Tolliver, Maren and Orla are invented names. README.md has the details. Read by src-tauri/src/session_room_tests.rs and crates/automation/src/trigger/engine.rs.
